description: Demolition of existing single storey rear extension and conservatory and erection of a single storey rear extension and dormer roof extension
decision_conditions: In the absence of detailed joinery drawings and specifications, insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate that the proposed replacement windows would preserve the significance, character and appearance of the locally listed building or the character and appearance of the John Innes (Merton Park) Conservation Area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policy HC1 of the London Plan 2021 and Policy D12.5 of the Merton Local Plan 2024.

<div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;">The proposed single storey rear extension, by reason of its scale, width, depth, bulk and siting, would appear as a dominant and unsympathetic addition that would erode the spacious garden setting of the locally listed building. As a result, the proposal would cause less than substantial harm to the significance of the heritage asset and fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the John Innes (Merton Park) Conservation Area. The identified harm is not outweighed by public benefits. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan 2021, Policies D12.1, D12.3, D12.4 and D12.5 of the Merton Local Plan 2024, and the statutory duties contained within Sections 66 and 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990</div>

<div style="font-family: &quot;Segoe UI&quot;; line-height: 20px;">The proposed side roof dormer, by reason of its siting and design, would detract from the distinctive roof form of the locally listed building, resulting in an unsympathetic and visually intrusive alteration which would cause less than substantial harm to the significance of the heritage asset and fail to preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the John Innes (Merton Park) Conservation Area. The identified harm is not outweighed by public benefits. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3, D4 and HC1 of the London Plan 2021, Policies D12.1, D12.3, D12.4 and D12.5 of the Merton Local Plan 2024, and the statutory duties contained within Sections 66 and 72 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990</div>
